import sys

def find_path(n, p):
    path = [n]
    while path[-1] != 1:
        path.append(p[path[-1] - 2])
    return path[::-1]

def main():
    import sys
    input = sys.stdin.read().split()
    n = int(input[0])
    p = list(map(int, input[1:]))
    path = find_path(n, p)
    print(" ".join(map(str, path)))

main()
